verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say users can prompt AI agents to fix, update, and ship code using project context directly from the Netlify dashboard. That is task delegation to an assistant built into the product UI. The support rests on a single short first-party line, with no detail on capabilities, limits or workflow. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what the in-dashboard agent can do and how tasks are scoped or reviewed, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
